evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep launched directly into 2.5-hour minimum and pricing without framing the call structure or time commitment upfront: 'We do have a two and a half hour minimum for every move.'
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Customer name (Ernest Moore), zip (78216), and timing (tomorrow/ASAP) were gathered. No explicit city-to-city route asked (intra-home move). Approximate size was clarified through discussion of items but not asked as a direct opening question.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moved directly to pricing after establishing the 2.5-hour minimum and responding to the customer's self-stated need.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (two-story), floors/stories (confirmed downstairs only), and special considerations (rugs, wheelchair accessibility, hospital bed on wheels) were discussed. However, walking distance, number of rooms, and additional stops were not systematically probed. Details emerged from customer volunteering rather than rep asking.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes — rep confirmed wrapping rugs in plastic and storing in garage: 'We can definitely help you wrap those up as well.'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: No box count or overflow check was asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor provided for the specific scenario: '$515 for Saturday (two and a half hours at $206/hour), or $480 minimum Sunday–Thursday; 15-minute intervals at $51.50 if over.' Personalized to the customer's specific job (furniture moving, rug wrapping, accessibility need).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Disclosed hourly rate ($206/hour), 15-minute billing intervals ($51.50 per increment), 2.5-hour minimum, no hidden fees (explicitly stated: 'no hidden fees of any type, okay'), and all-inclusive coverage of taxes, insurance, fuel, assembly/reassembly, and shrink wrap.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After the customer expressed price concern ('sounds like that you guys are a little out of my, out of my range'), Joanna pivoted to competitive positioning and email confirmation rather than pausing for the customer's reaction to the anchor.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'on time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts for your move.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: 'we will also include up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages' with no deductible or fine-print framing, and stated as included in the rate: 'that's already part of the service.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. After delivering both promises, the rep did not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' Instead, she moved directly to email confirmation and arrival windows.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. No version of 'What's still concerning you about this move?' was asked at the end. The call closed with a soft email-based follow-up.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: With out. Rep softened the ask into an email option: 'So just let us know if you want to go ahead with the booking so we can get you set up' immediately followed by 'or I'll send everything in the email.' Explicit softening: 'Just reach out to us respond to the email if you're ready to go ahead with the booking.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No mention of holding the rate or locking in pricing if the customer books today.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Customer name (Ernest Moore), email (EAMOTINE62@icloud.com), and arrival windows (8:30–9:00 AM or 12:30–2:30 PM options) were discussed. However, no specific date was confirmed (customer said 'as soon as possible' / 'tomorrow' but no explicit booking slot taken), phone number was not confirmed after being requested, and crew size and specific address confirmation are missing. Notes about the customer's concerns (wheelchair accessibility, rug wrapping) were mentioned but not formalized as booking notes.

top_strength: Joanna delivered clear, comprehensive pricing transparency upfront—all-inclusive rate, 15-minute billing increments, 2.5-hour minimum, and no hidden fees—and fully explained both the On-Time Guarantee and $2,000 damage coverage with no deductible.
coaching_note: Lead with the quid-pro-quo framing (time-boxed call + dependable quote) and ask 'their agenda' early to uncover concerns before pricing, not after; never soften the ask with an email out, and follow 'Does that feel fair?' with genuine silence before re-pitching.
booking_note: Customer said 'I'm gonna take a look at what you're sending me and then I'll decide' - no explicit commitment to book, only said they would review pricing and decide later
